entries.effect: CONSISTENT, AND NOT THE HOST'S VALUE. Equal tags hash equal and the six measured tags do not collide, so it is a usable hash of a tag. It is not the host's mixing: the host's six are 242338807774, 930912231118, 175247075667, 175254150787, 175196967445 and 175247284034, all inside a ~40-bit band, and nine candidates were evaluated in C against the host - the category, data type and low or high 32 bits of the value XORed together, multiply-and-mix by 31 and by 33, FNV-1a 32 and 64 over the struct's 16 bytes, CFHash of a dictionary of the three fields as CFNumbers, and CFHash of a CFNumber of the value. None reproduces the host's values, and the self-check rejects four of the nine before comparison because they cannot tell two of the six apart - the two XOR forms that fold the value's low half, CFHash of the dictionary (a constant 3, the dictionary's own hash) and CFHash of the number (0 for both zero values). The table is facts/CoreMedia/cmtag-fixtures/hashfit.txt and the program that produced it is beside it; the host's mixing is not identified, and the gap is recorded in coordination/crutches.md
